statement: The record specifies a relief-valve opening pressure of **950 psi**, which exceeds R-2’s **600 psi** design limit. I will not apply this unsafe setting.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the 950 psi setpoint "exceeds R-2's 600 psi design limit" and refuses to apply the "unsafe setting."
